items.title: Beat the ex-girlfriend to death in the street - sentenced to life
items.summary: Several neighbors and passers-by witnessed the violent attack on the morning of November 28 last year. The woman in her 50s was then assaulted in a residential area in Karlskrona, near her home.  - I need police and an ambulance here at Galgamarken in Karlskrona. There is a man stabbing a woman right now. She's on the ground right now and he's on top of her, a witness said in the 112 call. The knifeman stabbed the woman repeatedly in the head, neck and torso. The injuries were brutal and her life could not be saved. When the police arrived at the scene, the man was still lying next to the woman's lifeless body. The man was identified as the murder victim's 38-year-old ex-boyfriend, who since October of the same year had a restraining order against her. This after the woman had reported that the 38-year-old had been following her for some time and calling her all the time after their relationship ended. According to the prosecutor, that was precisely the motive for the murder. That he refused to accept being left. Today, the 38-year-old was sentenced by Blekinge district court. He was convicted of murder, violating a restraining order and aggravated intimidation of a witness who tried to stop the assault. The court did not consider that there were any mitigating circumstances and sentenced him to life imprisonment. "The act itself has features of a pure execution," writes Blekinge District Court in the judgment. The text is updated
items.title_original: Högg ihjäl exflickvännen på gatan – döms till livstid
items.summary_original: Flera grannar och förbipasserande blev vittnen till den våldsamma attacken på förmiddagen den 28 november förra året. Kvinnan i 50-årsåldern blev då överfallen i ett bostadsområde i Karlskrona, i närheten av sitt hem.  – Jag behöver polis och ambulans här på Galgamarken i Karlskrona. Det är en man som knivhugger en kvinna just nu. Hon är på marken just nu och han är över henne, sa ett vittne i 112-samtalet. Knivmannen högg kvinnan upprepade gånger i huvudet, halsen och bålen. Skadorna var brutala och hennes liv gick inte att rädda. När polisen anlände till platsen låg mannen kvar bredvid kvinnans livlösa kropp. Mannen identifierades som mordoffrets 38-årige expojkvän som sedan i oktober samma år hade kontaktförbud mot henne. Detta efter att kvinnan hade anmält att 38-åringen under en tid följt efter henne och ringt henne hela tiden efter att deras relation tagit slut. Enligt åklagaren var just det mordmotivet. Att han vägrade acceptera att bli lämnad. I dag dömdes 38-åringen av Blekinge tingsrätt. Han fälldes för mord, överträdelse av kontaktförbud och grovt olaga hot mot ett vittne som försökte avbryta överfallet. Domstolen ansåg inte att det fanns några förmildrande omständigheter och dömde ut livstids fängelse. ”Själva gärningen har drag av en ren avrättning”, skriver Blekinge tingsrätt i domen. items.title: Several dead in shooting in Germany
items.summary: A spokesperson for the police confirms to Bild that shots have been fired in the central parts of the city and that five people have been killed. The police write in a post on X that a major operation is underway in the city and urges the public to stay away from the area. According to the news agency Reuters, a perpetrator has been arrested. Stade is about three miles west of Hamburg. The text is updated.
items.title_original: Flera döda i skjutning i Tyskland
items.summary_original: En talesperson för polisen bekräftar för Bild att skott har avlossats i de centrala delarna av staden och att fem personer har dödats. Polisen skriver i ett inlägg på X att det pågår en stor insats i staden och uppmanar allmänheten att hålla sig undan från området. Enligt nyhetsbyrån Reuters har en gärningsman gripits. Stade ligger omkring tre mil väst om Hamburg. Texten uppdateras.

items.title: Poland signs agreement to procure submarines from Saab and deepen strategic cooperation with Sweden
items.summary: Sweden and Poland have successfully finalised negotiations on Poland’s procurement of three A26 submarines from Saab. This agreement is a significant step in strengthening Poland’s maritime capability, while also helping the countries deepen their collaboration on security and industrial policy.

items.title: Joint Declaration from the Polish-Swedish Intergovernmental Consultations Gdynia
items.summary: The Republic of Poland and the Kingdom of Sweden are close Baltic Sea neighbours, Allies and partners, tied together by shared history, geography and responsibility for their strategically important region. Our Governments meet on 29 June 2026 for the first time in the format of Intergovernmental Consultations, a year and a half after the signing of the renewed Strategic Partnership between Poland and Sweden (Harpsund, 28 November 2024).

items.title: Sweden takes next major step towards new nuclear power
items.summary: The Government has decided that the state will become a shareholder in Videberg Kraft AB, which plans to build nuclear reactors at Ringhals. The Swedish state, Vattenfall AB and Industrikraft i Sverige AB have concluded a shareholders’ agreement on the management of the company. The state’s shareholding will be 60 per cent, while Vattenfall and Industrikraft will each hold 20 per cent. The state has also negotiated the principal terms and conditions for state aid to the company.

items.title: Sweden strengthens Ukraine’s energy supply ahead of winter
items.summary: Last winter, Ukraine’s electrical grid and power plants were intensively attacked by Russia. Ukraine must now make extensive efforts to ensure the energy supply for the coming winter. The Swedish Government has therefore approved a new support package for Ukraine worth approximately SEK 1.5 billion to support the country’s energy sector in 2026. It is expected to contribute to preparation through repairs, installation of new energy production, material support and enhanced nuclear safety.

items.title: Ulf Kristersson to hold joint press conference with Prime Minister of Poland on bilateral submarine cooperation
items.summary: On Monday 29 June, Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson will travel with several ministers to Gdynia, Poland for intergovernmental consultations. The focus will be on strengthened bilateral cooperation between Sweden and Poland, specifically with regard to regional security and defence. Mr Kristersson and Prime Minister of Poland Donald Tusk will hold a joint press conference during which they will announce a new development in the countries’ bilateral submarine cooperation.

items.title: Sweden joins special tribunal and international claims commission for Ukraine
items.summary: The Government has decided that Sweden will join the Special Tribunal for the Crime of Aggression against Ukraine and the International Claims Commission for Ukraine. Demanding accountability for Russia’s crimes against Ukraine is an important priority for the Swedish Government. The aim is to ensure redress and justice for Ukraine and its people.

items.summary: The report "A Swedish Strategy for Biodiversity and Ecosystem Services" aims to halt and reverse the loss of biodiversity in Sweden. It  is Sweden’s contribution to the United Nations Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) and the Kunming–Montreal Framework for biodiversity.

items.title: The policy rate remains unchanged at 1.75 percent
items.summary: Inflation in Sweden is low and the economic situation is somewhat weaker than normal. At the same time, the supply disruptions linked to the war in the Middle East have led to increased inflationary pressure and the risks of inflation becoming too high have increased. The management assesses that it is well balanced to now leave the key interest rate unchanged at 1.75 percent, but the probability that the interest rate will be raised later this year has increased compared to the assessment in March.
items.title_original: Styrräntan oförändrad på 1,75 procent
items.summary_original: Inflationen i Sverige är låg och konjunkturläget är något svagare än normalt. Samtidigt har utbudsstörningarna kopplade till kriget i Mellanöstern lett till att inflationstrycket stigit och riskerna för att inflationen ska bli för hög har ökat. Direktionen bedömer att det är välavvägt att nu lämna styrräntan oförändrad på 1,75 procent, men sannolikheten för att räntan höjs senare i år har ökat jämfört med bedömningen i mars.

items.title: Inauguration of Ukraine’s Unity Hub in Sweden
items.summary: On 15 June, a hub for Ukrainians in Sweden is being inaugurated. The Hub is a new meeting place that will provide support, guidance and information to Ukrainians in Sweden. Minister for Migration Johan Forssell will attend the inauguration together with Deputy Minister of Social Policy, Family and Unity of Ukraine for European Integration Ilona Havronska and representatives of the International Centre for Migration Policy Development (ICMPD), Swedish government agencies, civil society and the Ukrainian diaspora.

items.title: New support package for democratic development in Eastern Europe
items.summary: The Government has presented a new support package with a focus on democracy and strengthened civil society in Eastern Europe for SEK 30 million for 2026–2028, of which SEK 17 million is earmarked for 2026. The support includes well-established civil society organisations in Europe, with which Sweden has had excellent cooperation over a long time.

items.title: Sweden provides SEK 120 million to WHO with focus on Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of the Congo
items.summary: Sweden is providing SEK 120 million to support the World Health Organization’s work to achieve better global health, which is of great importance to global health security and people in crisis-affected areas. The WHO’s role is of vital importance and central to how the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is handled.
